description:
Look up a gene by Ensembl gene ID or gene name/symbol in Ensembl Plants: species, location, assembly, biotype,
description and link. Names are searched in all of: pisum_sativum (Cameor v1a), pisum_sativum_gca024323335v2gb (pea ZW6), pisum_sativum_gca964186695v1gb (pea JI2822), vicia_faba, lupinus_angustifolius, phaseolus_vulgaris, cajanus_cajan_gca000340665v2gb (pigeonpea), vigna_unguiculata_gca004118075v2rs (cowpea), vigna_radiata, vigna_angularis, glycine_max, glycine_soja, arachis_hypogaea, medicago_truncatula, trifolium_pratense (red clover) (or only in species, if given).
e.g. 'GLYMA_01G000600', 'Psat1g000360'.
name: find_gene
